issues.jp_before: 薬[くすり]{を|o-object}飲[の]んだ{ものの|monono-although}、熱[ねつ]{が/は|ga-subject}まだ下[さ]がりません。
issues.problem: のに is equally natural with the same meaning but was not listed in the focus slot.
issues.action: Added のに as an alternative: {ものの/のに|monono-although}.

issues.jp_before: 日本語[にほんご]{を|o-object}勉強[べんきょう]している{ものの|monono-although}、新聞[しんぶん]{が/を|potential-ga}まだ読[よ]めません。
issues.problem: のに is equally natural but was not listed.
issues.action: Added のに as an alternative.

issues.jp_before: この部屋[へや]{は|wa-topic}駅[えき]{から|kara-from}近[ちか]い{ものの|monono-although}、家賃[やちん]{が|ga-subject}高[たか]すぎます。
issues.problem: Contrastive は is equally natural on 家賃 (non-focus slot).

issues.jp_before: メール{は|wa-contrast}送[おく]った{ものの/のに|monono-although}、返事[へんじ]{は|wa-negative}まだ来[き]ていません。
issues.problem: が is equally natural on 返事 (non-focus slot).

issues.jp_before: 田中[たなか]さん{は|wa-topic}優[やさ]しい{ものの|monono-although}、少[すこ]し頼[たよ]りないところがあります。
issues.problem: The が in ところがあります was left unmarked; every real particle must be a slot.
issues.action: Marked it as ところ{が|ga-existence}.

issues.jp_before: 引[ひ]っ越[こ]し{を|o-object}決[き]めた{ものの|monono-although}、荷造[にづく]り{は|wa-negative}全然[ぜんぜん]進[すす]んでいない。
issues.problem: のに is equally natural in the focus slot, and が is equally natural on 荷造り.
issues.action: Added のに to the focus slot and changed 荷造り's slot to {は/が|wa-negative}.

issues.jp_before: 駅[えき]{に|ni-destination}着[つ]いた{ものの|monono-although}、友達[ともだち]{は|wa-topic}まだ来[き]ていません。
issues.problem: のに is equally natural in the focus slot, and が is equally natural on 友達.
issues.action: Added のに to the focus slot and changed 友達's slot to {は/が|wa-topic}.

issues.jp_before: 自分[じぶん]{は|wa-contrast}料理[りょうり]{が|ga-stative}下手[へた]な{くせに/のに|kuseni-despite}、人[ひと]{の|no-possessive}料理[りょうり]{を|o-object}批判[ひはん]します。
issues.problem: The why was garbled and inaccurate ('blames the speaker's target for acting against what he has no right to do').
issues.action: Rewrote the why: くせに criticises him for judging others at something he is bad at himself.

issues.jp_before: 自分[じぶん]{で|de-means}決[き]めた{くせに|kuseni-despite}、結果[けっか]{が|ga-subject}悪[わる]い{と|to-quote}人[ひと]{の|no-possessive}せい{に|ni-change}します。
issues.problem: 結果が悪いと is the conditional と ('when the result is bad'), not a quotation.
issues.action: Changed the skill id to to-conditional.

issues.jp_before: お金[かね]{が|ga-existence}ある{くせに/のに|kuseni-despite}、彼[かれ]{は|wa-topic}一円[いちえん]{も|mo-total-negation}寄付[きふ]しません。
issues.problem: 一円も is a counter amount + も (mo-emphasis), not question word + も.
issues.action: Changed the skill id to mo-emphasis.

issues.jp_before: 疲[つか]れている{くせに/のに|kuseni-despite}、どうして休[やす]まない{の|no-final}。
issues.problem: くせに does not fit here: asking why a tired person won't rest is concern, not the contemptuous criticism くせに expresses, so the item models an unnatural use. The logic of the English is also muddled.
issues.action: Replaced it with 風邪[かぜ]{を|o-object}引[ひ]いている{くせに/のに|kuseni-despite}、どうしてアイス{を|o-object}食[た]べている{の|no-final}。 ('You've got a cold, so why on earth are you eating ice cream?'), f=1.

issues.jp_before: 犬[いぬ]{が|ga-stative}怖[こわ]い{くせに/のに|kuseni-despite}、彼[かれ]{は|wa-topic}大[おお]きい犬[いぬ]{を|o-object}飼[か]いました。
issues.problem: 飼いました means 'kept/raised (a dog)', not 'got a dog' as the English says.
issues.action: Changed the verb to 飼[か]い始[はじ]めました.

issues.jp_before: 自分[じぶん]{は|wa-contrast}いつも遅刻[ちこく]する{くせに/のに|kuseni-despite}、部下[ぶか]{の|no-possessive}遅刻[ちこく]{を|o-object}叱[しか]ります。
issues.problem: lv 1 is too high; the hardest words (部下, 叱る) are at about N2.
